screens.unchiku_header: こよみ先生の 秋の小話

texts: つばきはじめてひらく
さんさか → さざんか

screens.ending_note: こりんごさんは、これから、ぐんぐん育ちます
screens.ending_next: 次回も 秋の絵で 5問

opening.text: みなさん、こんにちは。こよみ先生です。さざんかの花が、咲きはじめましたね。今日は、秋の間違い探しを5問、いっしょに楽しみましょう。

rule.text: 左と右の絵をくらべます。90秒で、右の絵の違いを3つ探してください。

unchiku.text: ここで、ひと休み。秋の小話です。
今ごろの季節を、七十二候で「山茶始開」、「つばきはじめてひらく」といいます。
でも、この時期に咲きはじめるのは、さざんかの花なんです。
「山茶」は、つばきの中国の名前。さざんかは「さんさか」がなまったそうです。

ending.text: これで5問、おしまいです。おつかれさまでした。
15個の違い、いくつ見つかりましたか。画面で、今日の称号を見てくださいね。
次回も秋の絵で5問です。チャンネル登録をして、また来てください。

voice_override.u2: 今ごろの季節を、しちじゅうにこうで、つばきはじめてひらく、といいます。
voice_override.u3: でも、この時期に咲きはじめるのは、さざんかの花なんです。
voice_override.u4: さんちゃは、つばきの中国の名前。さざんかは、さんさかが、なまったそうです。

voice.credit: 音声：Fish Audio（AIで合成した音声です）

images.style: A warm Japanese picture-book illustration in soft watercolor with gentle colored-pencil outlines, like a cozy picture book for all ages, drawn with clear, crisp details. Late-autumn palette: sasanqua pink and white, apple red, warm browns, soft yellow and muted greens. Natural, hand-drawn, slightly rounded shapes; not geometric, not flat vector, not photorealistic. PORTRAIT-ISH composition, slightly taller than wide (about 8:9); the scene is arranged vertically, with a near foreground, a middle ground and a background stacked from bottom to top. Keep the top 10% of the picture simple (sky, eaves or leaves only) and the bottom 20% simple (plain floor, ground or pavement only): put every main object listed below in the middle part of the picture. The painting fills the entire canvas edge to edge: no white border, no blank paper margin on any side. No people. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere, including on signs, curtains, boxes and lanterns. Draw the scene from a little distance, so every listed object is SMALL in the picture, with plenty of space between objects. The main objects are clearly drawn, separated from each other with a little space around each, and fully visible (not cut off by the picture edge and not hidden behind other objects).
images.keep_alt: Keep everything else in the picture exactly the same: same composition, same position of every object, same colors, same style. Do not add or remove anything else. Leave no faint outline, ghost or smudge. No text.
images.keep_remove: Where an object is removed, fill the area naturally with what would be behind it, and leave no faint outline, ghost or smudge of the removed object.

questions.prompt: Scene: the front of a small old Japanese greengrocer (yaoya) in late autumn, seen from across the street, with a plain green awning without letters. Spread the main objects over the whole picture as described (upper left, upper right, middle, lower left, lower right), never clustered together. Objects: (upper left) a hanging round scale with a shallow pan, about one thirtieth of the picture width; (upper right) a row of three small red paper lanterns hanging from the awning, each about one fortieth of the picture width; (middle) a tilted wooden display stand with a flat basket holding exactly three red apples, each apple about one thirtieth of the picture width; (lower left) a wooden crate with white daikon radishes; (lower right) a small blue plastic bucket and a broom leaning on the stand; a pink sasanqua shrub beside the shop.
